details.zh: 1992年12月7日的归档航天器观测。由紫光、756 nm与968 nm滤镜影像组成的增强色图像，包含人眼不可见的近红外信息。不是当前月相，也不是可见光自然色。
details.en: Archived spacecraft observations from 7 December 1992. An enhanced-color composite of violet, 756 nm and 968 nm filter images, including near-infrared information outside human vision. Not the current lunar phase or natural visible color.

changes: None: downloaded the original NASA JPEG without resizing or color changes.

title.zh: 太阳动力学天文台的太阳观测
title.en: The Sun from Solar Dynamics Observatory

license: NASA media usage guidelines; acknowledge NASA; no endorsement implied

details.zh: 2018年5月15日的归档观测，由AIA 211、304及171埃通道组成的伪彩合成。原图标注约14:15 UTC的各通道拍摄时刻。颜色用于呈现极紫外信息，不是人眼直接看到的太阳颜色，也不是实时太阳。
details.en: An archived, false-color composite of AIA 211, 304 and 171 angstrom observations on 15 May 2018. The original image labels the channel exposure times around 14:15 UTC. The colors represent extreme ultraviolet information, not direct human vision; this is not a live view.

wavelength: AIA 211 / 304 / 171 angstrom (false-color composite, as labelled in the source image)
changes: None: downloaded the original NASA JPEG without resizing or color changes.
